title: 12 Best Craft Beer Bars in Berlin (2026)

venues.name: Protokoll Taproom
venues.verdict: The single most-recommended craft beer bar on every Berlin Reddit thread. Period.
venues.whatToOrder: Ask the bartender — the 20+ rotating taps change constantly with themed selections. They source exotic imports alongside German craft. Try a tasting flight if you can't decide.
venues.insiderTip: They host popup food events — check their Facebook for schedules. No food menu otherwise, but you can bring food in from nearby restaurants.

venues.name: Muted Horn
venues.verdict: The highest-rated craft beer bar in Berlin (4.8★). Run by Canadians who genuinely know their hops.
venues.whatToOrder: Specializes in hazy and sour beers — 15+ taps plus a massive fridge of cans and bottles. Staff will happily let you try before you buy.
venues.insiderTip: They have an online webshop for delivery/pickup. Arrive early on weekends for outdoor seating in the small beer garden.

venues.name: BRLO Brwhouse
venues.verdict: Berlin's biggest and most visible craft brewery. The gateway drug for anyone new to German craft beer.
venues.whatToOrder: Core range (Pale Ale, Porter, Berliner Weisse) is solid. Try seasonal brews on tap. They also make their own cider. Full restaurant menu available.
venues.insiderTip: Sits at the edge of Gleisdreieck Park in repurposed shipping containers. BRLO bottles available in most Berlin supermarkets and Spätis.

venues.name: Vagabund Brauerei
venues.verdict: The OG of Berlin craft beer. Founded by Americans, Vagabund was at the forefront of the city's craft beer movement.
venues.whatToOrder: Four revolving house-brewed taps plus guest ales. Everything is small-batch and brewed on-site. Try the seasonal specials.
venues.insiderTip: Far from the tourist trail in Wedding, near one of Europe's most respected brewing schools. Bottled beer available in Spätis.

venues.name: Hopfenreich
venues.verdict: Berlin's first dedicated craft beer bar — 15 thoughtfully curated taps and the largest draught selection in the city when it opened.
venues.whatToOrder: The IPAs, porters, and saisons set Hopfenreich apart. They also stock indie-brewed traditional styles. Ask the knowledgeable bartenders.
venues.insiderTip: Located in Kreuzberg's Wrangelkiez — surrounded by excellent döner kebab shops. Perfect beer-and-kebab pairing territory.

venues.name: Hops & Barley
venues.verdict: A proper neighborhood brewpub that brews on-site. Unpretentious, affordable, and consistently excellent.
venues.whatToOrder: House-brewed pilsner, dunkel, and wheat beer — plus rotating seasonals. The beer is unfiltered and only traveled meters to your glass.
venues.insiderTip: Watch the brewing happen behind the bar while drinking. More neighborhood local than hipster beer bar.

venues.name: Straßenbräu
venues.verdict: One of Berlin's most accessible craft breweries — right by Ostkreuz with 12 rotating taps of house-brewed beers.
venues.whatToOrder: Order a tasting flight (4 small beers) to sample the range. Berlin-tinged beer names. Also serves wine, cider, cocktails. No food — BYO.
venues.insiderTip: Tree-lined street with outdoor tables — a stone's throw from Ostkreuz S-Bahn. Easy first or last stop on a beer crawl.

venues.name: Biererei Bar & Vintage Cellar
venues.verdict: Part bar, part Späti for beer geeks. An insane selection on tap AND an even more insane fridge — global craft beer paradise.
venues.whatToOrder: Rotating taps plus a fridge with hundreds of global bottles. Belgian, American, Scandinavian — everything. Vintage cellar downstairs has rare aged bottles.
venues.insiderTip: The Berlin-style döner at Nefis around the corner is the perfect post-beer food, per multiple Redditors.

venues.name: Brauhaus Lemke
venues.verdict: The most tourist-accessible craft brewery — under the S-Bahn arches at Hackescher Markt with proper German food.
venues.whatToOrder: Try the tasting flight — 6 × 0.1L beers across pilsner, dunkel, hefeweizen, and seasonals. Classic German dishes (Schnitzel, pork knuckle) pair perfectly.
venues.insiderTip: Three Berlin locations — Hackescher Markt (most atmospheric), Alexanderplatz, and Charlottenburg. Opens at noon — good for day drinking.

venues.name: Heidenpeters
venues.verdict: A Kreuzberg institution inside Markthalle Neun. The original hipster brewery that kicked off Berlin's craft beer wave.
venues.whatToOrder: House-brewed beers fresh from the market hall. Pair with incredible food stalls at Markthalle Neun. Try whatever's seasonal.
venues.insiderTip: Go Thursday evening for Street Food Thursday — Heidenpeters + global street food = perfect Berlin evening. Closes early (8 PM most days)!

venues.name: Eschenbräu
venues.verdict: A hidden gem in Wedding — no-frills, unpretentious, and serving some of the cheapest quality craft beer in Berlin.
venues.whatToOrder: House-brewed pilsner and dunkel are reliably excellent. Seasonal beers rotate. At €3–€5 a pour, Berlin's most affordable craft beer.
venues.insiderTip: Same street as Hopfen und Malz beer shop. Pair both for a Wedding beer afternoon. Courtyard beer garden is a summer oasis.

venues.name: BKK Bier Kombinat Kreuzberg
venues.verdict: The locals' local — a neighborhood bar with some of the best locally brewed ales in Berlin via Schoppe Bräu.
venues.whatToOrder: Traditional beers alongside IPAs and seasonal brews from Kreuzberg's own Schoppe Bräu. Vibe is more Bundesliga than hipster.
venues.insiderTip: Hidden on a residential Kreuzberg street — feels like a real neighborhood spot. That's the charm.
